verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's own docs claim conversion between 200+ standard formats and name a few (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF), and GitHub notes read/write support for digital-film formats. That is only a headline-level statement of format coverage, not a documented input-to-output matrix. A community user asking where to find the full coder list suggests such a reference is not easy to find. missing for 10: a documented per-format read/write or conversion-pair table, any CLI listing of supported formats or coders shown in evidence, and independent corroboration that users can check a specific pair before converting.
